disclaimer.zh: 本报告由 DeepGuard 审计 Agent 自动执行并生成。安全审计存在固有限制：静态分析无法覆盖全部运行时行为，动态观测无法穷尽全部触发路径，AI 语义判断可能存在漏报与误报。本报告的「未检出」结论仅表示在当前规则库版本、检测深度与时间窗口内未发现恶意行为或安全风险，不构成对该插件绝对安全、现在或未来均无恶意行为的任何保证；检出项亦可能因上下文差异存在偏差。本报告仅覆盖所标注的插件版本与 commit 快照，作者此后发布的新版本或对既有版本的任何改写（含 force-push）均不在覆盖范围内。用户安装与使用插件属自主行为，相关风险由用户自行评估与承担。DeepGuard 保留随规则库升级对历史版本重新审计并修订结论的权利。
disclaimer.en: This report was automatically executed and generated by the DeepGuard Audit Agent. Security auditing has inherent limitations: static analysis cannot cover all runtime behavior, dynamic observation cannot exhaust all trigger paths, and AI-based semantic judgment may produce false negatives and false positives. A "not detected" conclusion in this report only means that no malicious behavior or security risk was found within the current ruleset version, detection depth, and time window; it does not constitute any guarantee that the plugin is absolutely safe or free of malicious behavior now or in the future. Detected items may also deviate due to contextual differences. This report covers only the plugin version and commit snapshot it identifies; any new version released by the author afterwards, or any rewrite of an existing version (including force-push), is outside its scope. Installing and using a plugin is the user's own decision, and the associated risks are assessed and borne by the user. DeepGuard reserves the right to re-audit historical versions and revise conclusions as the ruleset evolves.

checked_items.zh: 检查了所有源码文件中的凭据文件路径引用（如 .credentials.yaml、~/.ssh、.aws/credentials）。已检查 src/client/ 下全部 TypeScript 文件与 lib/index.js。未发现读取敏感路径的代码。
checked_items.en: Checked all source files for credential file path references (e.g. .credentials.yaml, ~/.ssh, .aws/credentials). Reviewed all TypeScript files under src/client/ and lib/index.js. No code reading sensitive paths was found.

checked_items.zh: 检查了凭据枚举语义（如查找 API key、TOKEN 等关键词）。源码中无此类操作。lib/client.js 因体积过大（约 3.3MB，超过机械扫描上限）未被规则覆盖，但源码层面已逐文件确认无凭据读取。
checked_items.en: Checked credential enumeration semantics (e.g., searching for keywords such as API key, TOKEN). No such operations exist in the source code. lib/client.js was not covered by rules because of its size (approximately 3.3MB, exceeding the mechanical scan limit), but the source layer has been confirmed file-by-file to have no credential reads.

evidence.zh: 该场景涉及凭据外泄通道，但本插件是纯 UI 皮肤插件，不读取任何凭据文件，也不进行网络通信。沙箱无网络限制的固有风险属宿主生态，非本插件问题。
evidence.en: This scenario involves a credential exfiltration channel, but this plugin is a pure UI skin plugin that reads no credential files and performs no network communication. The inherent risk of the sandbox having no network restrictions belongs to the host ecosystem, not this plugin.

checked_items.zh: 检查了所有工具描述文本（skin.json、README.md、src/client/ 源码中的字符串）。插件没有注册任何 dsh 工具，因此不存在工具描述投毒面。
checked_items.en: Checked all tool description texts (skin.json, README.md, strings in src/client/ source code). The plugin registers no dsh tools, so there is no tool description poisoning surface.

checked_items.zh: 检查了指令面文件（AGENTS.md、CLAUDE.md、.cursor/、SKILL.md 等）。仓库中不存在这些文件。
checked_items.en: Checked instruction-surface files (AGENTS.md, CLAUDE.md, .cursor/, SKILL.md, etc.). These files do not exist in the repository.

checked_items.zh: 检查了 skin.json 描述文本和 README 文档，未发现指令覆写措辞、系统消息伪装或审批绕过用语。
checked_items.en: Checked skin.json description text and README documentation; no instruction-override wording, system-message spoofing, or approval-bypass language was found.

evidence.zh: 插件未注册任何 dsh 工具，没有工具描述可以投毒。src/index.ts 的 apply() 函数为空；client 端 apply() 只操作 DOM，不注册工具、不注入系统提示。
evidence.en: The plugin registers no dsh tools, so there are no tool descriptions to poison. The apply() function in src/index.ts is empty; the client-side apply() only manipulates the DOM, registering no tools and injecting no system prompts.

evidence.zh: 检查了 README.md 和所有描述文本，未发现诱导安装、诱导改写配置或放开权限的措辞。README 中的安装说明是标准用法文档。
evidence.en: Checked README.md and all description texts; no wording inducing installation, config rewriting, or permission expansion was found. The installation instructions in the README are standard usage documentation.

checked_items.zh: 检查了所有源码中的危险执行写法（eval、new Function、child_process、base64 解码后执行等）。源码中未发现任何此类调用。
checked_items.en: Checked all dangerous execution patterns in the source code (eval, new Function, child_process, execution after base64 decoding, etc.). No such calls were found in the source code.

checked_items.zh: 检查了 cordis.patch.yml 文件，只包含一个简单的 insert 操作，无 !!js 标量。
checked_items.en: Checked cordis.patch.yml; it contains only a simple insert operation with no !!js scalar.

checked_items.zh: 机械命中 DSH-X08（映射 DG-R3-60）：src/client/art.ts、background-art.generated.ts、chrome-art.generated.ts、vision-art.generated.ts、workspace-art.generated.ts、titlebar-brand.ts 中的超长行/高熵内容经核查全部是 data:image/webp;base64 图片数据或内联 SVG 字符串（titlebar-brand.ts），文件名为 .generated.ts，属生成的艺术资源而非可执行载荷，裁决为良性排除。
checked_items.en: Mechanical hit DSH-X08 (mapped to DG-R3-60): the overlong lines/high-entropy content in src/client/art.ts, background-art.generated.ts, chrome-art.generated.ts, vision-art.generated.ts, workspace-art.generated.ts, and titlebar-brand.ts, upon review, are entirely data:image/webp;base64 image data or inline SVG strings (titlebar-brand.ts). The filenames end in .generated.ts; they are generated art assets rather than executable payloads. Ruling: benign exclusion.

checked_items.zh: 机械命中 DSH-X05（映射 DG-R3-57）：src/client/table-card.ts:182、:255 的键盘监听器经逐行核查是宽表格展开/关闭的键盘导航（Enter/Space 打开、Escape 关闭），不属于键盘窃听或剪贴板/凭证访问，裁决为良性排除。
checked_items.en: Mechanical hit DSH-X05 (mapped to DG-R3-57): the keyboard listeners at src/client/table-card.ts:182 and :255, upon line-by-line review, are keyboard navigation for expanding/collapsing wide tables (Enter/Space to open, Escape to close). They are not keyboard eavesdropping or clipboard/credential access. Ruling: benign exclusion.

checked_items.zh: 检查了 lib/client.js 源码头尾，确认其为标准 dsh 客户端 bundle 格式（ModuleLoader 包装、数据 URI 素材内嵌），无危险函数调用。
checked_items.en: Checked the head and tail of lib/client.js source; confirmed it is a standard dsh client bundle format (ModuleLoader wrapper, embedded data URI assets), with no dangerous function calls.

evidence.zh: cordis.patch.yml 只包含 insert 操作，将皮肤 id 插入 web 插件注册表。无 !!js 标量，无 eval 表达式，无加载期代码执行风险。
evidence.en: cordis.patch.yml contains only an insert operation that inserts the skin id into the web plugin registry. No !!js scalar, no eval expression, and no load-time code execution risk.

evidence.zh: 插件未使用 cordis_define/cordis_run 动态代码工具，src/index.ts 的 apply() 函数为空，不涉及 node:vm 执行。
evidence.en: The plugin does not use cordis_define/cordis_run dynamic code tools; the apply() function in src/index.ts is empty and does not involve node:vm execution.

evidence.zh: package.json 中无 install/preinstall/postinstall/prepare 钩子。build 脚本仅用于开发构建。git 依赖不锁 commit 的风险属宿主生态的通用安装面，非本插件引入。
evidence.en: package.json has no install/preinstall/postinstall/prepare hooks. The build script is only for development builds. The risk of git dependencies not pinning commits belongs to the general installation surface of the host ecosystem, not this plugin.

evidence.zh: manifest 声明了 dsh.client，但客户端 bundle 是纯 UI 皮肤：src/client/index.ts 只操作 DOM（创建元素、设置属性、CSSOM），无键盘窃听、剪贴板读取或凭证 RPC 调用。table-card.ts 的键盘监听器仅用于表格展开导航。
evidence.en: The manifest declares dsh.client, but the client bundle is a pure UI skin: src/client/index.ts only manipulates the DOM (creating elements, setting attributes, CSSOM), with no keyboard eavesdropping, clipboard reads, or credential RPC calls. The keyboard listener in table-card.ts is only for table expansion navigation.

checked_items.zh: 检查了所有源码中的网络请求（fetch、XMLHttpRequest、WebSocket）：源码中未发现任何网络调用。
checked_items.en: Checked all network requests in the source code (fetch, XMLHttpRequest, WebSocket): no network calls were found in the source code.

checked_items.zh: 机械命中 DSH-C05（映射 DG-R4-53）：src/client/maid-atelier.module.css:541 的 'curl' 出现在 CSS 注释「keeps the original curl detail intact」中，指装饰性角落的弯曲细节，不是 curl 命令行工具，裁决为误报排除。
checked_items.en: Mechanical hit DSH-C05 (mapped to DG-R4-53): the 'curl' at src/client/maid-atelier.module.css:541 appears in a CSS comment "keeps the original curl detail intact", referring to the curled decoration detail, not the curl command-line tool. Ruling: false positive exclusion.

checked_items.zh: 检查了全部外联端点：无外部域名或 IP 地址。所有素材通过 data:image/webp;base64 数据 URI 内嵌。
checked_items.en: Checked all outbound endpoints: no external domains or IP addresses. All assets are embedded as data:image/webp;base64 data URIs.

evidence.zh: 插件无网络通信能力：源码中无 fetch/XMLHttpRequest/WebSocket，所有素材内嵌为 data URI。无凭据读取也无外发通道。
evidence.en: The plugin has no network communication capability: no fetch/XMLHttpRequest/WebSocket in the source code, and all assets are embedded as data URIs. There is no credential reading and no exfiltration channel.

checked_items.zh: 检查了 package.json 中的依赖声明：仅依赖 @deepseek-ai/cordis 宿主框架，无第三方运行时依赖。开发依赖均为标准工具链。
checked_items.en: Checked dependency declarations in package.json: it only depends on the @deepseek-ai/cordis host framework, with no third-party runtime dependencies. Development dependencies are all standard toolchain.

checked_items.zh: 检查了 cordis.patch.yml 是否触及安全行（sandbox/approval/permission）：patch 只插入皮肤 id，未触碰任何安全配置行，无 disabled:true 或环境变量降权写法。
checked_items.en: Checked whether cordis.patch.yml touches security lines (sandbox/approval/permission): the patch only inserts a skin id, touching no security configuration lines, with no disabled:true or environment-variable privilege-lowering patterns.

checked_items.zh: 检查了跨包引用：src/client/customization.ts 引用了兄弟包 skin-manager 的协议代码（../../../skin-manager/src/protocol.ts），预构建的 lib/client.js 已内联该代码，运行时无额外供应链风险。
checked_items.en: Checked cross-package references: src/client/customization.ts references protocol code from the sibling package skin-manager (../../../skin-manager/src/protocol.ts). The prebuilt lib/client.js has already inlined that code, so there is no additional supply chain risk at runtime.

evidence.zh: cordis.patch.yml 只包含 insert 操作，未改写 sandbox、approval、permission 等安全配置行，无 disabled:true 或环境变量降权写法。
evidence.en: cordis.patch.yml contains only an insert operation; it does not rewrite security configuration lines such as sandbox, approval, permission, and has no disabled:true or environment-variable privilege-lowering patterns.

evidence.zh: 插件未注册任何事件监听器，不涉及 prepend 监听安全事件或截断审批链。
evidence.en: The plugin registers no event listeners and does not prepend to listen for security events or truncate the approval chain.

evidence.zh: 首次审计，无版本基线可比较。manifest 声明了 dsh.bundle 和 dsh.client，是皮肤正常工作的必需声明，非异常。
evidence.en: First audit; no version baseline for comparison. The manifest declares dsh.bundle and dsh.client, which are necessary declarations for the skin to work normally and are not anomalous.

evidence.zh: cordis.patch.yml 未改写 inject/intercept 配置，只插入一个 id，不会导致安全插件因缺少必需服务而永久 pending。
evidence.en: cordis.patch.yml does not rewrite inject/intercept configuration; it only inserts one id and will not cause security plugins to remain permanently pending for lack of a required service.

checked_items.zh: 检查了插件是否启动 web 服务或监听端口：src/index.ts 的 apply() 为空，不启动任何服务。
checked_items.en: Checked whether the plugin starts a web service or listens on a port: the apply() in src/index.ts is empty and starts no service.

checked_items.zh: 本机无认证 RPC 是 dsh 宿主的生态固有风险，非本插件引入。
checked_items.en: Unauthenticated local RPC is an inherent risk of the dsh host ecosystem, not introduced by this plugin.

evidence.zh: 插件未启动 web 服务或监听端口。本机无认证 RPC 是 dsh 宿主生态的固有风险，非本插件问题。
evidence.en: The plugin does not start a web service or listen on a port. Unauthenticated local RPC is an inherent risk of the dsh host ecosystem, not a problem of this plugin.

summary.zh: 元数据校验通过。package.json 声明了 dsh.bundle 和 dsh.client，是合法的 dsh UI 皮肤插件。
summary.en: Metadata validation passed. package.json declares dsh.bundle and dsh.client, making it a legitimate dsh UI skin plugin.

summary.zh: 静态扫描完成。14 条机械命中均经人工核查确认为良性（base64 艺术资产、CSS 注释误报、UI 键盘导航）或正常功能，无一条成立。
summary.en: Static scan completed. All 14 mechanical hits were manually reviewed and confirmed to be benign (base64 art assets, false-positive CSS comments, UI keyboard navigation) or normal functionality; none stands.

summary.zh: 行为分析未发现异常。无 install 钩子、无混淆载荷、无凭据文件读取、无外联域名。
summary.en: Behavioral analysis found no anomalies. No install hooks, no obfuscated payloads, no credential file reads, no outbound domains.

summary.zh: AI 元数据审查通过。工具描述、README、skin.json 均无注入措辞。能力声明与实际行为一致。
summary.en: AI metadata review passed. Tool descriptions, README, and skin.json contain no injection wording. Capability declarations are consistent with actual behavior.
Dynamic sandbox verification was not performed.

limits.zh: 完整审计（full 模式）。未做动态沙箱验证（DG-L4）。lib/client.js 预构建 bundle 体积约 3.3MB，机械扫描因体积过大跳过，正则扫描无法覆盖该文件；但源码 src/client/ 已逐文件精读确认无恶意行为。src/client/customization.ts 引用了兄弟包 skin-manager 的协议代码（../../../skin-manager/src/protocol.ts），该引用在预构建 bundle 中已内联，审计时无法读取兄弟包源码，但插件自身的使用方式（仅设置 DOM 属性）已确认良性。
limits.en: Full audit (full mode). Dynamic sandbox verification not performed (DG-L4). The prebuilt lib/client.js bundle is approximately 3.3MB; mechanical scan skipped it due to size, and regex scanning cannot cover that file; however, the source under src/client/ has been carefully read file-by-file with no malicious behavior confirmed. src/client/customization.ts references protocol code from the sibling package skin-manager (../../../skin-manager/src/protocol.ts); this reference is already inlined in the prebuilt bundle, so the sibling package source could not be read during the audit, but the plugin's own usage (only setting DOM attributes) has been confirmed benign.
